plate_comment: Alpha-chi interpolation used by the combustion reference and by the pilot / auxiliary timing and quantity families: interpolates linearly from the value of the lower map (param_1) to the value of the upper map (param_2) as the chi (param_6, in hundredths) runs from lower map number x 100 (param_4) to upper map number x 100 (param_5), holding the end values outside; then, unless alpha (param_7, percent) is 100, blends the result with the alpha 0 base map value (param_3). evidence: Code: the formula as written (value = v1 + (v2 - v1) x (chi - lower x 100) x 100 / (upper x 100 - lower x 100) / 100; then base + (value - base) x alpha / 100). The caller words are the struct fields chi_hundredths and alpha_percent.

plate_comment: Determines the base chi (the determine_chi() step of the combustion reference): evaluates the air density source (engine_load_input_value) and the coolant temperature source (fuel_demand_boost_input) with cm848_lookupProtectiveChi, keeps the record with the larger chi (cm848_selectChiSourceCode: 1 air density, 3 coolant temperature) and stores its desired chi, chi, level, low / high map numbers and source in the combustion_base_chi_* words. C_CBR_UHC_Charge_Tmptr_Limit in order. Dump: chi 400 from the EGR-off calibration (source 10), alpha 100, both map numbers 4, EGR off because fuel_mode_status_flags bit 1 is set.

plate_comment: Entry point of the combustion reference stage: runs cm848_selectChiAndAlpha, cm848_calculateCombustionFuelReference (gross fuel and fuel reference), cm848_calculateEgrFractionReference, cm848_calculateMassChargeFlowReference, cm848_calculateCombustionTimingReference, cm848_calculateChargeTemperatureReference and cm848_calculateNitrogenOxidesTargetReference in that order. (was cm848_processFuelDemandCalculations)

plate_comment: Maximum fuel of the chi-interpolated curve at the given engine speed (param_1): the same five 1-D curve lookups and chi / alpha blend as cm848_calculateCombustionChiMaximumFuel, but at an arbitrary speed. The fuel points are chi curve values, not protection thresholds.

plate_comment: Boot initialisation of the combustion reference: stores the RAM addresses of the four selectable maps (map 1..4) of the EGR fraction, mass charge flow, start of injection, charge temperature and NOx target references in the pointer words, and sets the lookup cache words of these lookups to 2. (was mpc555_initFuelDemandTablePointers)
evidence: Code: 20 pointer stores (0x402f5c ... 0x40471c) and the cache words; every map is 0x260 bytes (19 x 16 words) and the base map follows the three Chi maps, so the order Chi2 < Chi3 < Chi4 < base < map 1 in RAM is the e2m table order. The pointer words and caches are in the time-shared window 0x3F9800-0x3FDB30 and are not renamed here.

plate_comment: Calculates the off-nominal oxygen fraction adjustment engine_load_correction_blend: derives the reference air-fuel ratio ((1 - EGR fraction) x mass charge flow reference / fuel flow) and the reference intake oxygen fraction (0x76b = 0.232 minus the EGR dilution term), looks both up in the fuel_correction table, and divides the lookup of the actual value (fuel_load_correction_input) by it in Q13, capped at 0x2000. It does not calculate any injection timing. (was cm848_calculateFuelInjectionTiming)
evidence: Code: fuel_demand_rate_complement = 0x2000 - EGR fraction reference; fuel_injection_divisor_base = complement x MCF reference / (fuel_rate_rpm_factor x 64) (rpm x fuel quantity); 0x76b is 23.2 percent, the oxygen fraction of air; the result is the ratio of two lookups in the same 11-point table, capped at 0x2000. e2m CBO block: CBO_Air_Fuel_Ratio_Ref (+26), CBO_Intake_Charge_O2_Frac_Ref (+2A), CBO_FSNOx_Ratio_Ref / Actual (+28 / +2C), CBO_O2_Frac_Adj (+24) = engine_load_correction_blend. Code and e2m agree on every term.

plate_comment: Calculates the off-nominal charge temperature adjustment: the charge temperature reference minus the intake temperature (fuel_demand_boost_offset), clamped to the calibrated window, into fuel_demand_mode2_adjusted, and its table lookup into fuel_demand_mode2_correction_lookup. No manifold pressure is involved. (was cm848_calculateManifoldPressureOffset)
evidence: Code: charge_temperature_combustion_reference - fuel_demand_boost_offset (both 1/64 deg F) clamped by the calibrations 0x4059fc / 0x4059fe (both 0 in this calibration, so the adjustment is 0); signed lookup of the result. e2m CBO block: CBO_Delta_Charge_Tmptr (+0A = 0x40a522), CBO_Charge_Tmptr_Adj (+0C = 0x40a524), C_CBO_Delta_Charge_Tmptr_Min / Max.
Name and plate comment are right (CBO_Delta_SOI +1E and CBO_SOI_Adj +16: timing reference minus implemented main timing, clamped and looked up).

plate_comment: Looks up the off-nominal timing adjustment (injection_timing_reference_adjustment) from the composite adjustment fuel_demand_correction_input, sets its active flag, and adds it to the combustion timing reference clamped to -1023..1024 counts (fuel_correction_output). The adjustment is switched off (engine_load_correction_mode_flag = 1, output = the unadjusted reference) when EGR is off, alpha is 0, the chi is above the threshold or fuel_blend_correction_inhibit_flag is set. (was cm848_applyFuelDemandOffset)

plate_comment: Calculates the off-nominal compensation (CBO): the oxygen fraction adjustment and the charge temperature adjustment, their product clamped to the composite window (fuel_demand_correction_input), the timing adjustment and timing delta adjustment, and the NOx target scaled by both into fuel_demand_timing_correction. (was cm848_processFuelTimingCalculations)
evidence: Code: calls cm848_calculateOffNominalOxygenFractionAdjustment, cm848_calculateOffNominalChargeTemperatureAdjustment, multiplies their outputs (>> 13) and clamps by 0x405a08 / 0x405a0a, then calls cm848_applyOffNominalTimingAdjustment and cm848_calculateTimingReferenceDeltaAdjustment and forms the scaled NOx target. e2m CBO block: CBO_Composite_Adj (+18), C_CBO_Composite_Min / Max, CBO_bsNOx (+1A).

plate_comment: Entry point of the off-nominal compensation: copies the fuel reference into fuel_demand_limit_copy (the fuel input of the combustion limits), runs cm848_calculateOffNominalCompensation, then caches the mass charge flow reference (fuel_demand_rate_raw_cached), the EGR fraction reference (fuel_demand_high_limit_cached) and the gross-to-limit ratio (fuel_blend_load_ratio_cached) for the limit stage. (was cm848_storeFuelLimitValues)

plate_comment: Sets the lookup cache words 0x3fa6d2-0x3fa6da of the off-nominal compensation lookups (charge temperature adjustment, oxygen fraction tables, timing adjustment tables) to 2. It sets no table pointers. (was mpc555_initFuelTimingTablePointers)
evidence: Code: five word stores of 2 into the cached_axis_offsets words (&DAT_003fa6d2, fuel_load_correction_timing_interp_state, &DAT_003fa6d8, &DAT_003fa6da) used by the lookups of cm848_calculateOffNominalChargeTemperatureAdjustment, cm848_calculateOffNominalOxygenFractionAdjustment, cm848_calculateTimingReferenceDeltaAdjustment and cm848_applyOffNominalTimingAdjustment. Time-shared window; no word renamed.
